name: A Bro's Desire
source:
On a normal day of pandemic, Gael receives a message from a needy friend. Help him on his small journey.

[From [url=https://venus-lair.itch.io/a-bros-desire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
疫情期間的一個普通日子，蓋爾收到了一位渴望陪伴的朋友傳來的訊息。幫助他完成這段小小的旅程吧。

[摘自[url=https://venus-lair.itch.io/a-bros-desire]Itch.io[/url]]
